correctness.rationale: The required set comprises all FINITE length-n binary words without factor 001, not merely periodically admissible words. Counting no-00 words and terminal-zero suffix cases gives F_{n+3}−1 requirements. In the required-edge binary de Bruijn graph each of exactly F_{n−1} vertices starting 01 without 00 has excess outdegree one; matching deficit vertices end 00. Any augmenting flow for a circular covering walk decomposes into these many paths from deficits to surpluses; an overlap of ≥2 suffix/prefix bits is impossible because '00' cannot prefix a no-00 target. Thus each path needs n−2 edges. The last bit of each deficit is 0 and each surplus begins 0, so exactly n−2-edge connecting paths exist; the augmented balanced graph is strongly connected through 1^{n−1} and 0^{n−1} and hence Eulerian. This proves L_n=F_{n+3}−1+(n−2)F_{n−1} for all n≥3. Independent Euler constructions and coverage checks n=3..13 agree, and finite brute tests at n=3,4 corroborate minimality.
